claim: Patchline ships a negative-control outcomes calibration detecting residual confounding in the causal design. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the negative-control outcomes claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make negative-control-outcomes-gate`.
